constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class with a preserved exception.
constructor.param: The exception associated with the terminal outcome.

constructor.name: ConstructorWithOutput
constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class with exception and output-publication state.
constructor.param: The exception associated with the terminal outcome.
True when an output entry was successfully published for the Activity.

property.name: Code
property.summary: Gets the that describes the Activity outcome.

property.name: Exception
property.summary: Gets the exception associated with the terminal Activity outcome, if any.

property.name: HasOutput
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether an output entry was successfully published for the Activity.
property.remarks: A true value includes a published entry whose payload is null. This records actual publication, unlike , which expresses publication intent.

property.name: Message
property.summary: Gets an optional diagnostic message associated with the Activity outcome.

property.name: TimeStamp
property.summary: Gets the time when the Activity record was created.

main.summary: Defines values that describe the outcome of an Activity.

field.name: Failed
field.summary: The Activity did not complete successfully.

field.name: Faulted
field.summary: The Activity encountered an error and was faulted.

field.name: None
field.summary: No specific outcome is recorded for the Activity.

field.name: TimedOut
field.summary: The Activity did not complete before the configured timeout elapsed.
